verdict.rationale: PayPal documents public REST APIs with client-credentials OAuth token exchange and publishes OpenAPI descriptions for code generation and import. The documented API surface spans invoicing, disputes, payouts, server-side checkout operations and webhooks, plus Braintree's GraphQL API with an API Explorer. Probes confirm machine-readable REST docs and llms.txt are live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually driving the API end to end (all API evidence is first-party).
